# What a real Flexo MMS stack does with this project's RDF, measured by
# TestFlexoInterop. This is a ratchet: every line is adjudicated, and a change to
# one is a change in interoperability, not a change in the harness.
#
# Regenerate against a running stack (see .agents/skills/flexo-interop):
#   FLEXO_INTEROP=1 FLEXO_INTEROP_TOKEN=<jwt> \
#     go test -count=1 ./internal/interop/flexo -run TestFlexoInterop -update-flexo
#
# graph-load is the Turtle this project writes, loaded through Layer 1's graph
# endpoint. json-commit is the same model posted through the SysML v2 service's
# own commit path: the ground truth for what its read path can carry at all.
# Server-generated commit ids, timestamps and durations are not recorded.

[findings]
graph-load: 29 of 29 elements listed, 86 of 142 properties delivered
json-commit: 33 of 33 elements listed, 158 of 158 properties delivered
graph-load: 8 properties are in the sysx: extension namespace and are dropped unread — extractModelElementToJson ignores every predicate outside the sysml: vocabulary and the JSON annotation namespace (sysx:argumentIndex, sysx:declaredKeyword, sysx:endForm, sysx:endIndex, sysx:hasBody, sysx:memberIndex, sysx:relatedFeature, sysx:sourceText)
graph-load: no element carries sysml:elementId, which the service's own paged listing query selects on; the deployed listing route ignores that query and returns every subject of the branch graph instead, so the loaded elements are visible today only because paging is unimplemented
graph-load: 2 properties carry more than one value on some element (sysml:specializes on 1, sysx:relatedFeature on 1); a standard predicate with several values is skipped entirely unless a JSON annotation supplies the array
graph-load: 8 elements cannot be read directly because their ids are not [a-zA-Z0-9_-]+ — the encoder writes expression-node ids with a '.' (Interop__Battery__capacity.value, Interop__Component__mass.value, Interop__Mission___402.end0, Interop__Mission___402.end0.a0, Interop__Mission___402.end1, Interop__Mission___402.end1.a0, Interop__Rover__wheels.upperBound, Interop__Wheel__diameter.value)
graph-load: the roots endpoint reports 29 of 29 elements as roots (9 have no owner in the model); it filters on sysml:owner and sysml:owningRelatedElement, neither of which the graph carries
json-commit: the roots endpoint reports 1 of 33 elements as roots, 1 in the payload
both: the element listing answered 29 elements in one response at pageSize=10 — the service accepts pageAfter/pageBefore/pageSize and ignores them
json-commit: every multi-valued property survives, because the commit path stores each array whole as a JSON annotation literal alongside the typed triples
graph-load: 8 of 29 subjects of the graph are expression nodes or other subjects outside the element namespace
